Logistics, sold by Woodmont via Newmark (Schulz/Beyda/Welsh), terms not disclosed - resolves the pack's unverified date (https://www.roi-nj.com/2026/02/20/real_estate_development/woodmont-sells-54k-sf-woodbridge-class-a-facility-to-sagard-real-estate/)

2025-01-08: Sagard bought 19 Commerce Court West, South Brunswick, ~64,700 SF on 8.6 ac, built 1985 / renovated 2024, price undisclosed; second investment of its newer moderate value-add open-end fund; plans added dock doors, new office, ESFR (https://www.sagard.com/blog/2025/01/08/sagard-real-estate-expands-industrial-portfolio-with-acquisition-of-19-commerce-court-west-in-south-brunswick-nj/)

2026-03-10: Sagard Real Estate / La Caisse IOS JV announced with CAD 490M (~US$360M) initial GAV target; priority markets include greater NYC / northern NJ; first acquisition was two Moonachie (Meadowlands) IOS properties sold by Sitex Group via JLL (https://www.lacaisse.com/en/news/pressreleases/sagard-real-estate-caisse-launch-industrial-outdoor-storage-joint-venture; https://dailyvoice.com/new-jersey/pascackvalley/360m-industrial-push-begins-with-sale-of-bergen-county-site/)

2026-06-26: Sagard and Woodmont broke ground on the 278K SF two-building Rahway redevelopment (349 & 389 New Brunswick Ave), $56M BMO construction loan (https://www.roi-nj.com/2026/06/26/real_estate_development/woodmont-industrial-partners-sagard-real-estate-break-ground-on-redevelopment-of-rahway-site/)

Leadership: Rick Stone CEO; Mark Bigarel promoted to President 2025-09; Erik Good Senior Managing Director, Head of Acquisitions; Tom Stover Managing Director, Acquisitions; HQ Denver with regional investment offices in NYC, Charlotte, Austin, LA, SF (https://www.sagard.com/blog/2025/09/16/sagard-real-estate-announces-key-leadership-appointments/; https://www.sagard.com/blog/team/erik-good/; https://www.sagard.com/real-estate/team/)

AUM: ~US$6.0B per 2026 releases ($5.2B cited in a Jan-2026 release) (https://www.sagard.com/blog/2026/01/07/sagard-real-estate-expands-u-s-industrial-portfolio-with-core-plus-acquisition-in-auburn-washington/)

2024-09: Avenel 80 Essex Ave E bought at ~$300/SF with plan to re-lease at market after the tenant's lease expired 2025-10; seller still not named in any public source (https://www.roi-nj.com/2024/09/19/real_estate_development/sagard-real-estate-expands-portfolio-with-2-major-industrial-acquisitions-in-east-coast-markets/; https://re-nj.com/sagard-real-estate-adds-80000-sq-ft-avenel-warehouse-in-24-million-deal/)

Non-NJ context: 2026-04 Sagard unveiled a ~332,000 SF Staten Island warehouse; 2025-10 and 2026-05 San Leandro CA industrial and IOS buys; 2026-01 Auburn WA core-plus buy (https://www.sagard.com/blog/2026/05/14/sagard-real-estate-expands-industrial-portfolio-with-acquisition-of-ios-property-in-san-leandro-california/)

Montville Industrial Park buy dated 2024-08 (RE-NJ 2024-08-28): 7 buildings, 445,078 SF, 99% leased, 52 tenants, WALT under 2.9 years; $81.8M per CoStar headline (https://www.costar.com/article/354791263/longpoint-realty-purchases-north-jersey-industrial-portfolio-for-818-million; https://re-nj.com/longpoint-adds-445000-sq-ft-montville-industrial-portfolio-in-deal-with-first-industrial/)

Totowa Commerce Center financed with a ~$64M PGIM Real Estate acquisition loan; Longpoint's own site names Longpoint Fund III as buyer (https://re-nj.com/pgim-details-64-million-acquisition-loan-to-longpoint-for-totowa-industrial-portfolio/; https://longpoint.com/news-insights/totowa-commerce-center/)
340 Kaplan Dr, Fairfield (30,494 SF) bought 2024-09 via Longpoint Fund III (https://re-nj.com/longpoint-fund-buys-30000-sq-ft-fairfield-warehouse-from-sitex/)

Piscataway 121 & 131 Ethel Rd W ($19.4M, 101,454 SF, 100% leased, off-market, Lee & Associates Maffey/Komitor as buyer rep) is dated 2025-09, so it falls outside the 2019-2024 window (https://re-nj.com/longpoint-buys-101000-sq-ft-piscataway-industrial-portfolio-for-19-4-million/)

Longpoint sold Clifton Route 3 Industrial Park (97,145 SF, 4.5 ac, fully leased) to The Silverman Group in 2025-11 via C&W; no other 2025-2026 NJ purchase found (https://www.roi-nj.com/2025/11/25/real_estate_development/cushman-wakefield-arranges-sale-of-route-3-industrial-park-in-clifton/)

Fund III closed at ~$940M against a $750M target (https://www.costar.com/article/2072279920/longpoint-closes-third-industrial-fund-with-940-million); Fund IV opened 2025-12 with first close expected 2026-04, targets industrial, multifamily and manufactured housing, IMRF committed $35M (https://realassets.ipe.com/news/illinois-municipal-invests-in-crow-and-longpoint-us-real-estate-funds/10135567.article)

Daniel Frank - Partner focused on Northeast region operations, East Rutherford-based, former Avison Young Principal; most likely NJ decision-maker (https://ioreba.com/memberBio.asp?id=75; https://www.linkedin.com/in/danielrfrank/)

Founding partners: Dwight Angelini (Managing and Founding Partner), Nilesh Bubna, Reid Parker, Robert Provost III; NY/NJ named a Fund III primary market; 90+ professionals across 11 US and 2 European offices (https://longpoint.com/about-us/; https://longpoint.com/news-insights/longpoint-closes-on-second-largest-us-industrial-fund-this-year/)

NJ office listed as One Meadowlands Plaza, Suite 200, East Rutherford, ~7 staff, with a reported 2025-08 relocation - verify (https://www.loopnet.com/company/longpoint-property-group/east-rutherford-nj/v0r2qdfl/; https://cisleads.com/company/details/412123)
Roger Waggoner - Director, Acquisitions, ex-CanTex Capital; office not shown, likely Texas rather than NJ (https://www.zoominfo.com/c/longpoint-realty-partners-lp/373151581)
Firm strategy page: buys 'infill industrial warehouses at attractive prices to execute value-add strategies' (https://longpoint.com/strategy/)

273 Franklin Rd, Randolph ($4.5M, 28,000 SF, 10 small-bay units) was bought 2025-04 (not 2019-2024), sourced by Tom Consiglio of RRNNJ, and reached 100% occupancy by 2026-09 (https://re-nj.com/rrnnj-marks-lease-up-of-randolph-small-bay-building-after-sale-to-commerce-park-investors/)

801 E Edgar Rd, Linden (11,704 SF on 3.7 ac) bought 2026-07 all-cash in JV with Legacy and Saddleback; described as Legacy's 3rd property acquired in 24 hours (https://www.citybiz.co/article/875945/legacy-real-estate-developers-acquires-prime-linden-industrial-property/)

Spencer Pascal is CEO of Commerce Park Investors and Founder of Commerce Park Ventures; entered industrial in 2019 with a first Roxbury warehouse; his profile claims 5 industrial buys totaling 288,000+ SF in 2025 and a 1.7M+ SF portfolio (https://www.commerceparknj.com/our-team/spencer-pascal/; https://www.linkedin.com/in/spencer-r-pascal/)
